name: CloudPage_AccessToken
description: Short-lived, single-use tokens minted at email-send time so CloudPage URLs never expose raw SubscriberKey/EmailAddress in the querystring. See cloudpages/preference-center/preference-center.html and docs/security-guide.md#cloudpage-tokens.

fields.name: Token
fields.notes: Cryptographically random GUID, generated via AMPscript GUID() at send time

fields.name: Used
fields.notes: Not consumed on view, only informational — tokens are reusable within their validity window since preference centers are revisited, unlike one-time confirmation links
